packageRules.description: The one npm-managed pin in the repo is the pi stack in group_vars/all/versions.yml (pi_host_*/pi_dev_*/pi_web_*) — it is an APPLICATION version, not a Docker base image, so §7's stabilityDays argument applies verbatim. `pi_host_web_npm_version` is exempt: the pi-web cockpit self-updates inside @beta from the phone, so pinning that string would break its own update path (HD-484).
